caption: The drawing depicts a figure of a jester or clown-like character standing on a wheeled green box. The character is dressed in a red outfit with gold and white detailing, including a large ruffled orange collar and matching cuffs. The jester wears a tall, pointed red hat with a gold band and a gold ball at the tip. The face is painted with a lifelike complexion featuring a wide smile, visible teeth, and short dark hair. The legs are clad in orange trousers, and the lower legs are covered by white cross-hatched stockings paired with brown shoes. The green box on which the figure stands has four black wheels and is inscribed with the words "ON THE JOB SINCE 1865" in yellow letters on its front panel. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and the artist's signature, "RAYMOND NEUMANN," appears near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Cigar Store Figure: "Punch"
